reasoning: As of March 2026, France, UK, and Germany have historically avoided direct military strikes on Iran despite tensions over nuclear programs and regional activities. These European powers have generally pursued diplomatic approaches through the JCPOA framework and EU channels. A direct strike would represent an unprecedented escalation requiring extraordinary circumstances - likely only occurring if Iran directly attacked European territory or assets. Without evidence of such provocation or dramatic policy shifts, the probability of any of these three nations conducting qualifying strikes on Iranian soil or embassies within ~4 months is very low.
